role: Senior Software Engineer & Prog Metal Musician
title: Origin Story: 8-Bit & 7-Strings
description: Logic meets rhythm. Senior Software Engineer (Flutter/React/Astro & Cloud AI) with Enterprise background (.NET, Azure, SharePoint). When the IDE closes, I compose Prog Metal music and soundtracks.
paragraph1: Born in Palermo ('91), I grew up realizing early on that code and music spoke the same language. While others played Final Fantasy just for the (beautiful) story, I was dissecting battle system logic in RPG Maker XP and analyzing Nobuo Uematsu's chord progressions. Learning flow-control at 13 and harmonic complexity from JRPGs set the path.
paragraph2: My first .NET developer paycheck bought my first electric guitar. Since then, the journey has been parallel: a CS Degree by day, Lizard Academy and Dream Theater solos by night. Today, I don't choose between them. I bring engineering rigor to my Prog Metal compositions and artistic creativity to the Cloud Architectures I build.
